about: Values measured from the ORIGINAL Xbox 360 game (hardware capture or emulator). Keys are wfc_fidelity metric ids (group.id). Set 'original' to a number once captured; wfc_fidelity then turns the entry into a PASS/FAIL comparison in [original_vs_rebuild]. Keep 'method' precise enough to repeat. Never fill from the rebuild or from guesses.
capture_notes: Prefer 60 fps video with a frame counter. Distances: use authored geometry with known UU sizes (street tiles, door frames) or the debug position readout if available. Record build/region/spawn used in 'method'.

movement.robot_top_speed.method: jog straight along a measured street edge; distance / time over >= 3 s of steady motion

movement.robot_time_to_top_speed.method: frames from first stick deflection to steady stride speed

movement.robot_stop_time.method: frames from stick release to zero displacement (braking model check)

movement.robot_stop_distance.method: slide distance after release from full jog

movement.robot_backpedal_speed.method: hold back while aiming forward; distance / time

movement.robot_jump_apex.method: standing jump beside a wall of known height; apex frame

movement.robot_jump_airtime.method: frames from takeoff to landing, standing jump on flat ground

movement.robot_running_jump_distance.method: jog jump on flat ground; takeoff to landing footprint

movement.vehicle_hover_height.method: side-on capture of the hovering truck vs kerb height

movement.vehicle_cruise_speed.method: vehicle full throttle, no boost, distance / time

movement.vehicle_time_to_cruise.method: frames from throttle to steady cruise

movement.vehicle_dash_sustained.method: hold boost: how long speed stays above cruise (burst vs sustained)

movement.vehicle_dash_decay_time.method: frames from boost end to cruise speed

movement.vehicle_jump_apex.method: vehicle jump height above hover height

transform_momentum.r2v_forward.v_handoff.method: jog forward, transform while holding W: ground speed at the mesh handoff (side-on capture)

transform_momentum.r2v_forward.fold_time.method: frames from transform press (running) to drivable vehicle

transform_momentum.v2r_cruise.v_end.method: cruise, transform to robot holding W: ground speed on the first controllable robot frame

transform_momentum.v2r_cruise.fold_time.method: frames from transform press (cruising) to controllable robot

orientation.vehicle_max_yaw_rate.method: full-lock turn at cruise; heading change per second

orientation.camera_distance.method: chase cam pivot-to-lens distance (from screen-space size of Optimus at known height)

orientation.pawn_screen_x.method: horizontal screen position of the robot's spine in default chase cam (shoulder offset)

animation.aim_pitch_tracking.method: barrel pitch change / camera pitch change between looking ~23 deg up and down (side-on capture)

orientation.mouse_up_pitch_delta.method: sign only: default look inversion (positive = up looks up)

weapon.rounds_per_minute.method: audio/flash count over a full 50-round magazine dump

weapon.manual_reload_duration.method: frames from reload press to ammo counter refill

transform.to_vehicle_total_time.method: frames from transform press to drivable vehicle

transform.to_robot_total_time.method: frames from transform press to controllable robot

transform.transform_while_running_speed.method: speed during the first frames of a transform started at full jog (momentum carry)

collision.max_step_height.method: highest kerb/step walkable without jumping (use authored step meshes of known UU height)

collision.wall_slide_speed.method: push diagonally (45 deg) into a long wall; speed along the wall

muzzle.muzzle_bob_running.method: vertical muzzle travel over a jog cycle (side-on capture)
